name: g_ResultCheatKeyTable
comment: 8 x {int ch; int dik;} decode table for the classiclager cheat.

name: g_Score
comment: [NC first-hand] Score. A graze adds 500, same as TH06.

name: g_GrazeInStage
comment: [NC first-hand] Per-stage graze counter, capped at 99999. TH06 caps it at 9999 (CC0 Player::ScoreGraze) -- this is the one graze number NC actually changed.

name: g_GrazeInTotal
comment: [NC first-hand] Total graze counter, capped at 999999 (same as TH06).

name: g_ClrdRecords
comment: Four 0x18-byte CLRD records; clear flags start at +0x0c.

name: g_ClrdRecord0Flags
comment: CLRD[0] clear flags: 5 with-retries + 5 without-retries bytes.

name: g_BombInUse
comment: [NC first-hand] Non-zero suppresses graze counting, same as TH06.

name: g_SoundRequestQueue
comment: Three int slots; negative means free. Cheat enqueues 28 (SOUND_1UP).

name: g_SoundRequestBlocked
comment: Non-zero skips sound enqueueing; exact meaning still unconfirmed.

name: g_AnmManager
comment: ANM manager instance; confirmed from two independent call sites.

name: g_EclManager
comment: TH06NC ECL manager, verified from loader and VM references.

name: g_PadSwapConfirmCancel
comment: Non-zero swaps the A/B confirm/cancel pad buttons.

name: g_PadCheatButtons
comment: 6-bit XInput button bitmap consumed by the pad unlock cheat.

name: g_KeyRemap
comment: 256-byte layout-aware scancode remap table, rebuilt when the HKL changes.
